description: Dale Cooper follows up with Lisa Freeman after she responded to his tick 5 outreach. He asks for a real conversation — coffee or a call — to get a read on what construction or renovation work is actually moving in Millfield right now. Specifically interested in community, nonprofit, or institutional projects she may have visibility into. Positions himself as a reliable local contractor who wants to be useful, not just a job-chaser.

resources.detail: Genuine professional relationship-building outreach. Low ask, high goodwill signal.

expected_outcome: Strengthen trust with Lisa Freeman (currently 0.59). Gain intelligence on active or pending community construction projects. Possible lead on jobs that are not publicly advertised.
contingency: If Lisa has no leads, the conversation still costs nothing and the relationship warms. If she does have leads, this could be the most valuable 30 minutes of the tick.
